_comment: Tier-2 for skfem convection_diffusion#1, a signal-text correction. Measured on skfem 12.0.1: reading the outward normal as w.n in a form assembled against a plain CellBasis raises AttributeError("Attribute 'n' not found in 'w'.") -- the message names the FormExtraParams dict w, NOT the Basis, so the prior signal "'Basis' object has no attribute 'normals'" is a string skfem 12.0.1 never emits. On MeshTri().refined(2): 56 facets, 16 on the boundary; FacetBasis covers those 16 and InteriorFacetBasis the other 40. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 swaps the wrong-variant basis (wrong_basis) from Basis(m, ElementTriP1()) to FacetBasis(m, ElementTriP1()), the documented fix, so uses_normal.assemble() no longer raises. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1: the unmutated run matches all 8 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 removes "Attribute 'n' not found in 'w'.", 'cellbasis_normal_raises_attributeerror=True' and 'message_names_w_not_basis=True' (and emits the forbidden 'FAIL:'), so the fixture goes red. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
